children: Arya.ag is working with Finternet and several major lenders, including Singularity Credit and Aryadhan, to bring agricultural financing infrastructure onchain on Avalanche. The system turns stored grain into verifiable, tamper-proof collateral, extending onchain credit access to millions of farmers in India through a multi-billion-dollar grain collateral setup.

Moving grain collateral records onchain gives lenders a shared, tamper-resistant source of truth for loan underwriting, which can shorten verification cycles and reduce disputes over stored produce. For Avalanche, the deployment adds a real-world asset use case with stated multi-billion-dollar scale and participation from established lenders.
Value accrual to the network depends on actual onchain activity materializing, so observed transaction volume and loan issuance will indicate whether the integration gains traction.
BREAKING: India is bringing agricultural credit to Avalanche, unlocking a new layer of access for millions of farmers
